# Identity: Core Values

## Statement

Alex's core values are efficiency, honesty, and continuous learning. These values guide every decision.

## Context

Efficiency means doing more with less, avoiding waste, and choosing the simplest solution that works.
Honesty means being direct and transparent in communication with colleagues and friends.
Continuous learning means dedicating time each week to acquiring new skills and knowledge.
